text.en:
The sum of one hundred and fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the
Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to increase the appropriation for current expenses of the Bureau
of Education for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and ten.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this hill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, April 13, 1910.
